scripts.postinstall: git config core.hooksPath .githooks 2>/dev/null || true; test -e CLAUDE.md || ln -s AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md || true
scripts.//audit-ignore: image-size GHSA-w3rx-r6r6-pgpr and GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq are ignored, not unfixed: the fix published as image-size 2.0.4, and Metro pins ^1.0.2, so taking it means forcing a major version on the React Native development toolchain. Syncular never passes ICNS, JXL, or HEIF input to image-size, which is the only code the advisories cover. Drop the ignore when Metro accepts image-size 2. The svgo/postcss/sharp advisories are fixed for real, via the root overrides above.
scripts.check: bun run version:check && bun run check:code
scripts.check:code: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run knip && bun run test && bun run verify:runtimes
scripts.//test-split: multi-tab runs in its OWN bun process (test:isolated), NOT for a syncular race — that cross-operation interleaving race is fixed in the core (SyncClient #opChain). The residual is a bun 1.3.14 native crash: many Worker OS-threads each opening bun:sqlite under BroadcastChannel/fetch load intermittently segfaults the runtime (repros with zero syncular code; browsers use per-worker OPFS files so it cannot happen in production). Isolation reduces cross-file thread contention. Collapse this split once bun fixes the segfault.
scripts.test: bun run test:main && bun run test:isolated && bun run test:downgrade
scripts.test:isolated: bun test packages/web-client/test/multi-tab.test.ts || (echo 'retrying once: documented bun-native worker+sqlite corruption, see package.json //test-split' && bun test packages/web-client/test/multi-tab.test.ts)
scripts.//test-downgrade: runs in its own process: it creates a detached git worktree of 8b22d819 and imports the pre-change @syncular/client by absolute path to prove the container file survives a real old-binary reset.
scripts.build:packages: bun run clean:packages && for p in core crypto server server-hono server-workers crdt-yjs web-client react typegen tauri testing create-app; do echo "building @ packages/$p" && tsc -p packages/$p/tsconfig.build.json || exit 1; done && bun run fix:esm && bun run build:bins
scripts.verify:runtimes: bun run --cwd packages/web-client verify:node && bun run --cwd packages/server verify:node
scripts.build:sites: bun run version:check && bun run --cwd apps/docs build && bun run --cwd apps/demo build:static
scripts.fix:esm: node scripts/fix-esm-extensions.mjs packages/core/dist packages/crypto/dist packages/server/dist packages/server-hono/dist packages/server-workers/dist packages/crdt-yjs/dist packages/web-client/dist packages/react/dist packages/typegen/dist packages/tauri/dist packages/testing/dist packages/create-app/dist
